name: Chile
summary: Chile taxes residents on worldwide income at progressive rates up to 40%, but a foreigner who settles in Chile is taxed only on Chilean-source income for the first three years (LIR art. 3, extendable). Afterwards foreign gains and dividends are ordinary income (top 40%, credit for foreign tax). Gains on Chilean listed shares bear a 10% single tax in 2026 (repealed from 2027 by the reform promulgated on 9 Oct 2026). Inheritance tax is 1%-25% per heir above a 50 UTA exemption for children, but for a foreigner's estate foreign assets count only if acquired with Chilean funds. No wealth tax.

regimes.name: Ordinary tax residence (after the first three years)
regimes.description: Worldwide taxation: Global Complementary Tax (0%-40%) on foreign dividends and most capital gains; 10% single tax on Chilean listed-share gains (2026); partial imputation credit for Chilean dividends; inheritance tax per heir.
regimes.eligibility: Residence: more than 183 days in any 12-month period, or domicile (intent to remain) from arrival (Deloitte 2026; PwC). Applies to foreigners from their fourth year of residence.

capital_gains.summary: Capital gains are generally ordinary income subject to the Global Complementary Tax (top 40%). Gains on Chilean shares with stock-market presence bear a 10% single tax (Law 21.420, since Sept 2022); a reform promulgated on 9 Oct 2026 (not yet published) repeals this from 1 Jan 2027, making them non-taxable. Gains on Chilean real estate by individuals are exempt up to UF 8,000 lifetime and then taxable at a 10% single tax option or the GCT.

capital_gains.rate_basis: Top GCT rate 40% (Deloitte 2026: 0%-40%; PwC: maximum raised from 35% to 40% from 2020) for foreign listed shares, unlisted shares and foreign real estate. Chilean listed shares: 10% single tax in 2026. Chilean real estate: 10% single-tax option.
capital_gains.professional_trader: Habitual share trading is business income (first category tax plus final taxes).
capital_gains.important_exceptions: Announced (promulgated 9 Oct 2026, awaiting publication): 10% tax on listed-share gains repealed from 1 Jan 2027.
open_questions: Real-estate 10% single-tax option and UF 8,000 exemption are from memory of LIR art. 17 N8; not re-verified at source.
Treatment of foreign real estate gains assumed to be ordinary income.

dividends.summary: Dividends from Chilean companies are subject to the Global Complementary Tax with a credit for 65% of the 27% corporate tax (partially integrated system), giving about 30.75% personal tax on the cash dividend at the top rate. Foreign dividends are taxed at up to 40% with a credit for foreign taxes.

dividends.rate_basis: Domestic: gross-up 100 profit, 27 CIT, 73 dividend; GCT 40% x 100 = 40 minus credit 0.65 x 27 = 17.55 gives 22.45, i.e. 30.75% of the cash dividend. Foreign: 40% top GCT.
dividends.withholding_outbound: 35% additional tax on dividends to non-residents with 65% (treaty residents 100%) credit for corporate tax.
dividends.treaty_network: About 35 treaties including Argentina, Australia, Brazil, Canada, China, France, Italy, Japan, Mexico, Spain, Switzerland, UK and the US (in force).
dividends.holding_company_notes: CFC rules attribute passive income of controlled foreign entities.
open_questions: Unilateral credit for foreign tax on dividends from non-treaty countries (LIR art. 41 A) not verified; PwC says credit requires a treaty.

wealth_tax.property_tax_note: Real property tax (contribuciones) on cadastral value: 1.4% non-rural (residential exempt up to about CLP 58 million) and 1% rural, with a surcharge for high total property holdings (Deloitte 2026).

inheritance.summary: Ley 16.271: progressive tax on each heir's net share, 1% up to 80 UTA rising to 25% above 1,200 UTA (marginal). Spouse, parents and children are exempt on the first 50 UTA of an inheritance (5 UTA for gifts). In the estate of a foreigner, assets abroad are included only if acquired with resources from Chile (art. 1). With UTA = CLP 865,812 (October 2026) the child exemption is CLP 43,290,600.

inheritance.spouse_note: The surviving spouse sits in the same group as children: the first 50 UTA of the inheritance is exempt, then the same 1%-25% scale applies, with no marital relief beyond that (Ley 16.271 art. 2 and the table instructions, group I).
inheritance.gift_tax: Gifts taxed on the same scale; exemption for children only 5 UTA per gift. The reform promulgated on 9 Oct 2026 grants a one-year 50% reduction of gift tax (not yet in force).
inheritance.foreign_assets: Art. 1: assets abroad are included in the inventory; in the estate of a foreigner they are included only if acquired with resources from Chile. Foreign tax paid is creditable. Scored as local_assets_only for a foreign family whose wealth was built abroad.
inheritance.domicile_rules: Tax applies to Chilean estates; SII rulings (Ord. 1619/2013) confirm no tax for a foreign non-resident estate with no Chilean assets.
inheritance.important_exceptions: Brackets are in UTA and move monthly with inflation.
open_questions: Ley 16.271 text on SII is updated to Law 21.210 (2020); later changes (Law 21.420 2022 gift rules) and the temporary 50% gift-tax cut in the 2026 reform are not reflected.
What counts as foreign assets 'acquired with resources from Chile' for a long-resident foreigner (e.g. reinvested gains) is not settled.

regimes.name: New foreign resident: Chilean-source income only for three years (LIR art. 3)
regimes.description: A foreigner who takes up domicile or residence in Chile is taxed only on Chilean-source income during the first three years from arrival; the period can be extended by the Regional Director.
regimes.eligibility: Foreign nationals establishing residence or domicile in Chile; applies automatically from entry (Deloitte 2026; PwC). Extension at the tax authority's discretion.

capital_gains.summary: Foreign-source gains are outside Chilean tax for three years; Chilean gains taxed as standard.

corporate.summary: First category tax 27% (partially integrated system); 12.5% for SMEs in 2025-2027. The reform promulgated on 9 Oct 2026 cuts the general rate to 25.5% (2027), 24% (2028) and 23% (from 2029).

us_citizen_notes: The US-Chile income tax treaty is in force (PwC list). US citizens remain subject to US federal tax.
